pages.title: [SAMPLE] Education Center — Tuition Assistance
pages.text:
# Education Center (SAMPLE DATA — not real)

The Education Center helps Marines plan their off-duty education, use Tuition Assistance (TA), and get academic counseling.

- Location: Building 0002, Placeholder Hall
- Phone: 555-0102 (placeholder)
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.

## Tuition Assistance
TA eligibility rules are set by the Marine Corps and can change. Marines should meet with an education counselor before their first TA request. Requirements commonly include completing a TA orientation and having an approved education plan on file. See the Education Center for current eligibility details.

## Joint Services Transcript (JST)
The JST documents military training and experience with recommended college credit. Marines can view and request their JST online at https://jst.doded.mil. Counselors at the Education Center can help you read your JST and send it to a school.
